question.text: Which of the following statements is TRUE regarding the annual audit requirement for research analysts under SEBI regulations?

answer.text: Annual audit must be conducted by a SEBI-empanelled auditor only
Annual audit is required only for research entities with more than 50 clients
Annual audit must be conducted by a member of ICAI, ICSI, or ICMAI and the report submitted in the manner specified by SEBI
Annual audit requirement applies only to non-individual research entities

explanation.text: The Logic: As per the regulations, a research analyst or research entity shall conduct an annual audit in respect of compliance with these regulations by a member of ICAI, ICSI, or ICMAI, and submit the report in such manner as specified by SEBI. The Trap: The requirement applies to all research analysts and research entities -- not just non-individual ones or those above a client threshold. Note: The source does not name a recipient for the report -- it only specifies that submission must follow the manner specified by SEBI.
